idleDescription: Type to search rooms, streamers or areas.
noResultsDescription: Try other words, or another target.
noLiveResultsDescription: Offline rooms are hidden; you can show them.
unsupportedDescription: Switch to another platform and try again.
webSearchSelectPlatform: Choose a platform before searching the web
webSearchUnavailable: This platform has no web search
webSearchUnsupportedTitle: The in-app web view is unavailable here
webSearchUnsupportedDescription: Open this search in the system browser instead.
webSearchExternalFailed: Could not open the system browser
linkFailed: The link did not resolve to a room
scopeHint: “All” searches every ticked platform; keep at least one.
coverageLiveOnly: {site: String}: finds rooms that are live now.
coverageLiveAndOffline: {site: String}: finds live rooms and some offline ones; filter with “Include offline”.
coverageChannelLookup: {site: String}: channel id or link only; finds offline channels, no keywords or nicknames.
coverageRoomLookup: {site: String}: room id or live link only; no nickname search.
coverageShowcaseSnapshot: {site: String}: an id or link finds the room exactly; any other word filters the platform's current showcase by nickname, offline streamers excluded.
coverageLocalChannels: {site: String}: searches the channels imported on this device.
coverageWebOnly: {site: String}: no in-app search — browse the popular and area pages, or paste a live link.
coverageUnavailable: {site: String}: no in-app search — browse the popular and area pages, or paste a live link.
partialFailureDescription: The network or a proxy may have blocked these: {platforms: String}
webView2MissingBody: This Windows has no WebView2; open the web search in the system browser, or install WebView2 first.
webVersionDescription: Open the platform's web version in the app to see its rooms.
coverageShortLiveAndOffline: Finds live rooms and some offline ones
coverageShortRoomLookup: Room id or live link only
coverageShortShowcase: A nickname filter over the current showcase
noteKuaishou: Kuaishou: guest searches may be limited; sign in to a platform account and retry, or paste an official share link to open the room directly.
noteKuaishouShort: Guest searches may be limited; official share links work — sign in and retry

noteTwitcasting: TwitCasting: keywords find live channels only; a channel link finds an offline channel too.
noteKilakila: KilaKila: search anchors by nickname, or enter a UID or paste a profile or share link; the live state is confirmed in the room.
noteKilakilaShort: Find anchors by nickname, UID or link
noteWeibo: Weibo: a session id or live link finds the room exactly; other words filter the current showcase by nickname, and the live state is confirmed on entering.
noteWeiboShort: Session id or live link only
noteYoutube: YouTube: keywords find live channels only; a channel link, @handle or video link finds an offline channel too.
scopeTagsHint: “Anchors”: the platform searches streamers. “Web”: the platform's web search page can be opened.
scopeSummary: Searches {count: String} platforms at once; what each finds differs — tap to review.
scopeSummaryExcluded: Searches {count: String} of {total: String} platforms ({excluded: String} excluded) — tap to review or change.
anchorUnsupported: {site: String} cannot search streamers; switch to “Rooms”.
